result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few visual defects: inconsistent vertical alignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, text clipped at the screen edge without truncation handling, and a partially rendered category chip. Overall 4 issues found: 2 major and 2 minor.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is vertically offset compared to the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' cards — its image, title, and delivery price sit noticeably lower, breaking the row's baseline alignment.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed, equal height and align image thumbnails and text blocks to the same top edge so titles and prices sit on consistent baselines.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is hard-clipped by the screen edge with no ellipsis or fade, making the text appear cut off/broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis within the card's own width, or add a fade/peek treatment so partially visible carousel items look intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The last category filter chip (after 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge showing only a tiny sliver, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than a scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing so the next chip peeks in more visibly (e.g., 30–40% visible), or add a gradient fade at the edge to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20%) is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, with its title and details hidden, which at first glance looks like missing content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding/scroll inset so partially visible cards don't collide with the nav bar, or let the nav bar overlay with a subtle background blur to clarify the content continues beneath.
